 Follow When do Social Security payments go out for November? See schedule
 Mike Snider, USA TODAY Sat, October 31, 2026 at 10:02 AM UTC 2 min read Add Yahoo as a preferred source to see more of our stories on Google. When do Social Security payments go out for November? See schedule Some Social Security payments  will go out a day early in November, due to the Veterans Day holiday.
 Social Security  benefits, which are paid mostly to  recipients who are older or retired , typically go out on Wednesdays. If your birthday falls between the first and 10th days of the month, your payment is scheduled to arrive on the second Wednesday of the month (for November, that is Nov. 11), according to the  Social Security Administration's calendar .
 However, since Wednesday, Nov. 11, is Veterans Day, Social Security payments will go out a day earlier.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement As for other recipients, if you were born between the 11th and 20th, you get paid on the third Wednesday of the month (Nov. 18); those born after the 20th of the month are paid on the fourth Wednesday of the month (Nov. 25), according to the  SSA calendar . Social Security recipients who began getting benefits before May 1997 are scheduled to be paid on Nov. 3.

 Social Security payment schedule for November 2026
 The Social Security Administration's payments calendar for  2026  and  2027  are available online – and there's a handy calendar below – so you can check the schedules for budgeting purposes.
 The check you get in October is technically your Social Security retirement benefits for September, while your October benefits are covered by the check that arrives the following month, according to  the SSA . Here's the SSA's schedule:
 Advertisement Advertisement Tuesday, Nov. 10:  Birth dates between the 1st and 10th of the month.
 Wednesday, Nov. 18:  Birth dates between the 11th and 20th of the month.
 Wednesday, Nov. 25:  Birth dates between the 21st and 31st of the month.
 SSI payment schedule for November and the rest of 2026
 Supplemental Security Income , which is also administered by the  SSA , is a benefit program for persons with limited or no income or resources, those 65 or older, those who are blind or have a qualifying disability, including children with a disability, according to the SSA website .
 SSI recipients are typically issued payments on the first business day of the month – in November, since the first day of the month is a Sunday, recipients will have their payment issued on Friday, Oct. 30.
 Here are the dates for SSI payments for  2026 , according to  the SSA calendar :
 Advertisement Advertisement Friday, Oct. 30, 2026
 Tuesday, Dec. 1, 2026
 Thursday, Dec. 31, 2026
